data_source.name: Building Data Genome 2 (BDG2)
data_source.attribution: Miller, C., Kathirgamanathan, A., Picchetti, B. et al. (2020), Scientific Data 7, 368; buds-lab.
data_source.modifications: Selected hourly data; model forecasts; estimated floor allocation and synthetic PV/storage/grid fields.

hvac_method.policy: district production excluded; cooling:cold*derivedfanpumpfactor; heating:steam*derivedfanpumpfactor; shoulder:sum; no compressor or boiler electricity; not measured electrical submeter
hvac_method.cap: current:min(actual_kw,point_kw); future:point_kw only, no future measured electricity
hvac_method.future: thermal readings held from origin; mode switches by known target month; no target-time meters
hvac_method.missing: past-only last valid reading within24h, else null; missing not zero; seasonal inactive meter not needed
hvac_method.share_denominator: current:actual_kw; future:point_kw; null for absent estimate or zero denominator
hvac_method.units: raw meters:kWh thermal per1h; thermal_kw:kW thermal; electric estimates:kW electrical; share:fraction0-1
hvac_method.floor_partition: HVAC estimate is a subset of existing predicted electric floors; exact0.1kW bounded largest remainder, no double counting
